regressions.source: LoanManager.sol _queueNextPayment: payments[paymentId_] = PaymentInfo({_uint24(...), _uint24(...), _uint48(...), _uint48(...), _uint128(...), _uint128(...), newRate_}); accountedInterest += _uint112(...); emit PaymentAdded(...); _updateIssuanceParams -> emit IssuanceParamsUpdated
regressions.issue: In this tail, once a word is written through the held pointer _578 (= mem[64] - 224), reads at mem[64]-based offsets are no longer resolved: five reverts the old text decoded ('LM:UINT24', 'LM:UINT128' x2, 'LM:UINT112', 'LM:UINT48') are raw 'revert with memory', and the two events lose their data words (the first three, or all three).
regressions.rule: Keep the relation between a held read of mem[64] and the pointer's later value (here mem[64] = _578 + 224), so that stores through _578 + k (k < 224) are known not to alias [mem[64], mem[64] + n) and revert/log data stay resolvable.
regressions.verified: reading only (old text lines 2963-2997 decode them)

regressions.rule: When one arm of a branch only reverts, print it first as 'if not cond: revert ...' and keep the other arm flat, even when that arm ends with stop.
